verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms telli serves an llms.txt at docs.telli.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. First-party docs explicitly say the specs can be downloaded to give coding agents machine-readable API context, and doc pages are served as .md files. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt itself or how to point an agent at it (e.g., whether an llms-full.txt exists).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
